goal: Isolate standard transaction rule unit tests so checks run independently without shared state
Prevent accidental state leakage between assertions to make test failures easier to diagnose
agreement: Approval after author addressed comments and resolved script duplication (janb84)
Thinks it may not be worth human review effort unless trivial to review (maflcko)

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because test cleanliness and isolation provide modest leverage compared to new coverage or speed
Eliminating shared mutable state helps diagnose failures, but cleanup remains deferrable
